article.content: Patrick Stewart, best known for his roles in Star Trek and X-Men , has died at age 86. A message posted to Stewart's Instagram account says the actor died in his Los Angeles home on Wednesday "following a brief and poignant journey with Alzheimer's Disease and Lewy Body Dementia." Born in 1940 in Mirfield, Yorkshire, England, Stewart began his acting career in theater . He eventually landed the role of Captain Jean-Luc Picard in Star Trek: The Next Generation , which ran from 1987 to 1994.
